name: Harley
title: Hell Saviors
description: The leader of the bike hog biker gang, the Hell Saviors. Rumor has it she is wanted for an assortment of crimes. Above all, she is a magnanimous girl who values loyalty.
introduction:
Leader of the bike hog biker gang, the Hell Saviors.
Rumors abound that she is wanted across the continent for countless crimes such as train robberies, bank heists, vandalism, and illegal hog grazing, yet no one has ever been able to confirm this.

Harley never forgets a favor and does not target ordinary people, valuing loyalty above all else. Though she looks small and cute, she is called "boss" by her rough gang members and commands their absolute loyalty.
She hates to lose and has a bold personality that shows through actions rather than words.

On the other hand, she also has the innocent side of a girl her age, and it is rumored that this rare glimpse of innocence is the source of the gang's loyalty.
